    ``````markdown
    ## Verification Steps

    Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8123/chart.html. Verify that the page renders a scatterplot matrix: a grid of multiple scatter-plot panels is drawn (not a blank page and not an error message), with many point/circle marks visible inside the panels. Verify that no Vega/Vega-Lite error text (for example 'Javascript Error', 'Uncaught', or a red error box) is shown on the page.

    ## Result Format
    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",
        "reason": "A detailed explanation of why the test passed or failed."
    }
    ``````
